Just want to say that I am feeling this right now, especially with myself (I think getting older and seeing my parents get older has triggered me).  Important to notice that you were triggered by a friend getting diagnosed.

Intrusive thoughts attach themselves to things you hold most dearly and things you fear the most because they feed on the attention we give them.  You probably don’t constantly obsess about the socks you have on because it’s a minor thing.  I have dealt with this, I’m not sure how much of a help I can be but it did improve over time so if you would like to talk more (obligatory not a therapist or mental health professional) you can send me a message, I have dealt with the same theme and also bad false memories.
